tokens.v: Shoot from the hallway through the open kitchen doorway: the dark doorframe cuts the left third and the top edge, the kitchen beyond held in a bright rectangle of window light. Stand the pouch close to the lens on the near counter so it owns the lower-right third, roll-top creased down, its wrapped matte kraft label carrying AMBLE in large clean capitals, ink sunk into the uncoated stock, one seam corner lifted. 28mm at f/8 at eye height, everything from doorframe to far tiles readably sharp. Steam ribbons off a just-boiled stovetop kettle and drifts across the light.
